what: Vulnerable. About 1,000 pups died of heat at Yarra Bend in one week in January 2026.
More prone to heat stress than brushtails; found on the ground by day in heatwaves.
Endangered. Numbers fell 99.5% from 2018 to 2021; city lights pull the survivors off course.
As wetlands dry, turtles walk the roads looking for water, and die on them.
Breathes through its skin. When ponds and drains dry, so does it.
